snippet.title: Why Is This Woman Sobbing During A Flight?
snippet.description: An airline passenger allegedly burst into tears – for three hours. According to travel blogger Tomiko Harvey, the woman sitting next to her wanted her aisle seat. When Harvey refused, her seatmate proceeded to weep. The woman wanted Harvey to switch seats with her husband, who was in a middle seat three rows up on a 10-hour flight. The woman wanted her husband to sit next to her, so she could rest her head on his shoulder, Harvey said in a video post, which has gone viral with nearly 5 million views.

Relive the excitement of a Dussehra mela in a 1990s Indian village—school holidays, childhood wishes, Ferris wheel rides, handmade toys, Ravana Dahan and warm jalebi brought home for the whole family. 🎡🧡

“Amma, please ask Pitaji to take us to the fair!”

For Munna and his little sister Gudiya, Dussehra begins with one very important request. As their mother prepares festive food at home, the children eagerly wait for their father’s answer. His surprised reaction soon turns into a smile—and their village fair adventure begins!

Walk with the family through the fields to a colorful village mela. Join the siblings as they enjoy the Ferris wheel, share a sweet moment at the toy stall, watch the glowing Ravana effigy and taste freshly made jalebi.

The celebration ends back home, where everyone sits together to enjoy puris, aloo-kaddu sabzi, creamy kheer and the jalebi they brought from the fair. A simple family meal becomes a childhood memory to treasure. 🍽️✨
